verdict.rationale: The trade mark guidance page publishes an actual amount on-page rather than a contact form: "Registering a trade mark costs at least £205." But that figure is a floor, not the exact fee for a given transaction. No fee amounts are evidenced for patents, renewals, or other transactions. Missing for 10: exact per-transaction fee schedule (e.g. per-class trade mark costs), published amounts for patent filing and renewal fees, independent corroboration of the fee pages.
